explanation: The forecast fails to capture the structural break where actuals move from a baseline of ~60 to a new level of ~90. The red predicted line stays at the lower level for several steps before eventually catching up. This is characteristic of an unadapted shift. Evidence: 1. Actuals show a significant upward trend/level shift starting in 2024-01. 2. Predicted values are consistently under-predicting (positive bias) during the transition. 3. The error pattern shows a long sign run of positive residuals (actual > predicted).
